name: Put the person's name here
_comment_search: What to search YouTube for. Add nicknames and common misspellings. More terms = more coverage = more quota used.
_comment_lookback: How many days back to search. 30 is a sensible start.
_comment_events: What was happening in this person's life. This is the part that answers 'is it bad for THIS person RIGHT NOW'. Types: film_release, trailer_drop, award_show, tournament, tour, live_controversy, legal_matter, brand_campaign, election, other. days_before/days_after set how long the event counts for - nothing is allowed to go stale silently.
